create.name: Wendy Moran
create.bio:
Wendy Moran is a Hatha yoga teacher and retreat leader who lives in Liverpool and runs Amity Yoga Wellness, a small practice focused on women. She trained with the British Wheel of Yoga and has been teaching for more than eighteen years, and she continues her own study of pranayama and yoga philosophy with the senior teacher Sama Fabian.

Her classes rest on traditional Hatha yoga and the eight limbs, blended with gentle flowing sequences, and each one leaves time for breathing practice, meditation and deep relaxation. Close to home she teaches weekly women's classes in Rainhill and Whiston on the eastern edge of Liverpool, a monthly two-hour Relax & Restore morning that ends in yoga nidra, and summer sessions outdoors in Stadt Moers Park. A few times a year she leads women's yoga and spa days at the Hope Street Hotel in the city's Georgian Quarter, and she takes small groups away for weekend retreats that combine yoga, meditation and walking in the Lake District and Snowdonia, as well as an occasional longer retreat abroad. She also offers private one-to-one sessions and designs bespoke retreats for groups.

courses.title: Relax & Restore Sessions
courses.description: A monthly two-hour Saturday morning in Whiston that moves through gentle Hatha yoga, breathwork and meditation and closes with a long yoga nidra. Open to beginners and regular practitioners.

courses.title: Amity Yoga Spa Day Retreat
courses.description: A women-only day at the Hope Street Hotel in Liverpool combining yoga, breathing practice and relaxation sessions with time in the hotel spa. Days are held a few times a year, with the next on 24 January and 21 March 2027.

courses.title: Autumn Yoga & Wellness Retreat for Women, Lake District
courses.description: A small weekend retreat at Nab Cottage in Rydal with daily Hatha yoga, meditation, breathwork and relaxation, fell walks and vegetarian meals, and free time to enjoy the valley.

courses.title: Private Yoga & Bespoke Retreats
courses.description: One-to-one yoga planned around the student after a short video call, which can include flowing or gentle practice, breathing work and yoga nidra. She also designs retreats and workshops for groups.
